data_types.evidence: GoogleAuthService and UserRepository store the signed-in profile. Sharing also stores invitee/member names.
Google/Firebase authentication and Firestore user profiles; manually entered invitation email addresses.
Firebase UID, ownership, member access and audit fields. No Crashlytics custom user identifier found.

Conservative disclosure of the available Google profile-photo reference within federated account information. ProfileScreen displays FirebaseAuth.currentUser.photoURL. No Vinoozy upload of label photos: OCR/barcode processing is local.
Optional manually entered invitations and member relationships. No device address-book permission or import.
Firebase Sessions transitive to Crashlytics and ML Kit technical feature-event telemetry. No Firebase Analytics SDK is integrated.
Firestore cellar inventory, quantities, wine details, dates, drinking records, ratings and notes. Core inventory sync is required; individual notes and sharing are optional.
AppServices._configureCrashlytics enables collection in real release builds. No user opt-out switch exists. Error reporting sanitizes application-provided sensitive strings.
Crashlytics, Firebase Sessions and bundled ML Kit collect app/device metadata, latency, technical errors and feature metrics.
Crashlytics installation UUID, Firebase Installation ID, ML Kit per-installation identifiers and Play Integrity attestation material. No advertising ID permission/use.

sharing_rationale: Google/Firebase storage and diagnostics are evaluated under the service-provider exception; ML Kit and Play Integrity official disclosure states no onward transfer to third parties.
Invited-cellar access and the confirmed opening of a photo in Lens/another selected app are specific user-initiated transfers that users reasonably expect.
No data sale or advertising transfer found. OFF online requests are disabled in this AAB; enabling them requires a new assessment.
not_selected: Location: no location permission or application location inference found; IP use for authentication security alone is not assumed to be location collection.
Financial information, health/fitness, email message contents, SMS, audio, videos, files/documents, calendar, browsing history: no relevant collection found.
In-app search history: catalog queries remain local with OFF disabled.
Installed apps: no installed-app inventory collection by Vinoozy; optional Play Integrity environment details are not configured in application code.

console.final_save_blocked_by: Target audience and content must be completed first
